question: Is the least bond along patterns of knots within four consecutive distinctions a count of missing knots, with a unit that does not depend on the process that made the pattern?

definitions.bases: 800 distinctions, 10 each, seeds sha256 MK:label:base: newest-four growth at q in {0, 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9}; Bernoulli band (each knot within four consecutive present with probability p) at p in {0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9}.
definitions.pairs: 8 per gap g in {16, 32, 64, 128, 256} per base, jitter 0..3; and per base the eleven non-overlapping stretches of 64 from 40.
definitions.counts: M (missing knots summed over windows), D (distinct missing knots), M3, M4 (by span), W2 (windows with >= 2 missing), gap; L exact (bonddp.least_bond, margin 8).

public_inputs.code: census.py (sha256 8b433f808c7821b81b26d09522ae5cda14028f29a98c4a3fb87f5b10f9872650) beside this file; fates.py (sha256 72d3571ed66dddaa6c517b3ce29ce14ae72c008c025669e2ef071b77b73eba35) and bonddp.py (sha256 8bc70ca09b96ed24689a828297671302dc3f8895617d764b1ea3823aea7eb608); pysat; numpy.
public_inputs.run: census.py from the repository root, then census.py --summary; output artifacts/MISSING-KNOTS-20261112-001A/MISSING-KNOTS-20261112-001A-E001_missing_knot_count/.

forbidden_inputs: Changing settings, seeds, readings, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
primary_observable: See the predictions; each is evaluated by census.py --summary.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Uniform knots (one late jump, J1) for LIFE-JUMPS; the newest-four replication (M1) for MISSING-KNOTS.

predictions.M1: newest-four: slope of L on M in [0.09, 0.13] at every q, pooled R2 >= 0.95.
predictions.M2: Bernoulli band: slope in [0.09, 0.13] at every p.
predictions.M2r: rival: slope at p = 0.9 <= 0.8 x slope at p = 0.5.
predictions.M3: every cell with >= 5 bases having >= 6 stretches with a bond: median within-base slope of L on M in [0.09, 0.13].
predictions.M4: reported: the count with the steadiest slope.

decision_rules.each prediction: holds or fails as stated in research/MISSING-KNOTS-20261112-001/preregistration.md

stop_rule: One run and its summary; a hand-off to the referee thread; report.
runtime: About fifteen minutes on six workers; systemd-run --user -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0.
